cli.usage:
Usage: sevdesk-mcp [--profile <name>]
       sevdesk-mcp setup [--add | --list | --remove <name>]
       sevdesk-mcp <command>

Without a command, starts the MCP server on stdio.

Options:
  --profile <name>  Use only this profile; execute rejects any other account

Commands:
  setup      Manage profiles (sevDesk accounts); tokens go into the OS keychain
  --help     Show this help
  --version  Show the version

Options for setup:
  --add            Add a profile or replace its token (the default)
  --list           List the profiles with company name and read-only state
  --remove <name>  Remove a profile and delete its token from the OS keychain

Exit codes:
  {success}  Success
  {failure}  Error while running
  {usage}  Usage error (unknown command or option)
cli.invalidProfileName: Invalid profile name: {profile} (1 to 32 characters: a-z, 0-9 and -)
setup.noTty: setup needs an interactive terminal and has no options for scripts. Without one (CI, Docker), set SEVDESK_API_TOKEN (and optionally SEVDESK_PROFILE) in the environment of the MCP server instead.
setup.intro: This adds a sevDesk account as a profile. Its API token goes into the OS keychain, never into a file.
setup.askProfile: Profile name (1 to 32 characters: a-z, 0-9 and -):
setup.askReplace: Profile {profile} ({company}) already exists. Replace its token and settings? {choices}
setup.notReplaced: Profile {profile} was left as it is.
setup.noKeychain:
No OS keychain is available ({reason}).
setup stores API tokens only there: a token in a plain file can be read by any process and any backup, and it grants full access to the bookkeeping.
Without a keychain (headless Linux, WSL, Docker), set SEVDESK_API_TOKEN (and optionally SEVDESK_PROFILE) in the environment of the MCP server instead.
setup.invalidToken: That is not an API token: it is empty or contains spaces or other invalid characters.
setup.tokenRejected: sevDesk rejected the token (HTTP 401). Copy the whole token from sevDesk again and run setup again.
setup.checkFailed: The token could not be checked with sevDesk: {detail}
setup.unsupportedSystem: This account's bookkeeping system ({version}) is not supported; sevdesk-mcp supports only system {supported}.
setup.askReadonly: Read-only? A read-only profile can read everything but change nothing. {choices}
setup.keychainWriteFailed: The token could not be stored in the OS keychain ({reason}).
setup.configWriteFailed: The token is in the OS keychain (service {service}, account {profile}), but the config file {file} could not be written ({reason}). Fix that and run setup again.
setup.invalidConfig:
{message}
Fix the config file and run setup again.
setup.clientEntry: Add this command to your MCP client: {command}
setup.removeNoTty: setup --remove asks before it removes a profile and needs an interactive terminal for that. Nothing was removed.
setup.listEmpty: There are no profiles yet. sevdesk-mcp setup adds one.
setup.unknownProfile: There is no profile {profile}. sevdesk-mcp setup --list shows every profile.
setup.askRemove: Remove profile {profile} ({company}) and delete its token from the OS keychain? {choices}
setup.notRemoved: Profile {profile} was left as it is.
setup.keychainDeleteFailed: The token could not be deleted from the OS keychain ({reason}).
setup.configRemoveFailed: The token of profile {profile} is deleted from the OS keychain, but the config file {file} could not be written ({reason}). Fix that and run setup --remove {profile} again.
setup.removed: Profile {profile} ({company}) is removed; the OS keychain holds no token for it any more.
setup.removeClientEntry: If an MCP client runs sevdesk-mcp with --profile {profile}, remove that entry from its config.
setup.entryKindLocal: Running from the local checkout {root}: the client entries start its build with this Node.js, not the published package. After every update, run bun run build there again.
setup.entryKindNpx: The client entries start the published package with npx.
setup.askReplaceEntry: {client} already has an MCP server named {entry} ({file}). Replace it? {choices}
setup.entryAdded: {client}: {entry} is added. Restart {client} to use it.
setup.entriesRemoved: {client}: {entries} removed. Restart {client} for the change to apply.
setup.backedUp: The previous file is saved as {backup}.
setup.clientUnreadable: {client}: {file} could not be read ({reason}); it was left as it is.
setup.clientUpdateFailed: {client}: {file} could not be updated ({reason}); it was left as it is.
setup.clientChanged: {client}: {file} changed while you answered, so it was left as it is.
setup.clientsLeft: Client configs not changed so far are left as they are.
setup.otherClientsEntry: For other MCP clients, use this command: {command}
setup.removeOtherClientEntry: If another MCP client runs sevdesk-mcp with --profile {profile}, remove that entry from its config.
